[quote=valddera;60888985]Finally...

[Spoiler=Unity for greater good.]As the Valdderan civil war was near it's ending, many considered it already has ended a month ago. The breakaway nation of Democratic Valddera proposed an agreement to unify Valddera under one government, as the acting interim leader, Nadir Suleiman, announced to step down of his position claiming he "isn't fit to rule an entire country" and was only operating on war, as Valdderan authorities executed the ISV leader, Hussan Al-Amin. The ISV is basically pointless now, near ceasing to exist. Which officially marked the end of war, a political party who proposed to run the government of the new Valddera accepted the deal with the breakaway nation, coming to an agreement to let Democracy into the nation. As the new post war government of Valddera is now a Democratic socialist republi, with the new president rumored to be called Harun Arman. The leader of the political party that came to power in Valddera, now the unified government and country finally rest after war. Everyone mourns for the people who lost their lives, either in battle, or anywhere else.[/Spoiler]

[Spoiler=New decisions of the government]The new government of Valddera doesn't change anything about the current relations and encourages to form new alliances and relations with other nations. The Valdderan Government also reaches out to Daesunite government to negotiate a new alliance that broke under the old government, urging for peace. This applies the same for the newly unified neighbors, Tirakan, Valddera wishes to make strong alliances and trades.

The Valdderan Government also request to join or partnership with the THEP alliance, to stabilize and refine the nations even more. As Valddera already has strong ties with some of the THEP members.

Valddera also proposes to cede the two occupied isles near Tirakan to the Tirakani nation, claiming to stabilize and improve relations with Tirakan and recognize the sovereignty of the new Government.

Valdderan Government also wishes to rejoin back the OIC organization, apologizing for their actions and wanting to restore stability and peace with other nations.[/spoiler]

[Spoiler=Sports and infrastructure rebuilding]The Valdderan Government quickly begins reconstructing and refining new buildings from the war conflict, using the brutalist architecture to rebuild and quickly arrange new homes. As this style of architecture costs less and has capacity, other than that Valddera quickly begins to reconstruct buildings and refine stadiums for the upcoming Erene world cup being hosted in the country. With proposals to have other nations come and help rebuild and refine buildings, stadiums and what's needed for living and infrastructure.[/spoiler]

[b]Office of the Secretary General[/b]

[u]Turning Over a New Leaf[/u]

[i]بسم الله الرحمن الرحيم[/i]

The EOIC is pleased to see a peaceful end to the conflict in Valddera, and signs of a genuine and truly representative coalition government there. As such, we shall have a vote on whether or not Valddera should be allowed back into the organization. I (Baladullah) vote yes, and in shaa Allah there will be a more peaceful and constructive future for Valddera.

Also, the Baladullahan delegation to the EOIC has proposed using the General Fund to assist the new government in Valddera with reconstruction, re settling displaced residents, emergency relief, and humanitarian aid. Baladullah has pledged to give a $50 billion one time contribution to the General Fund for this purpose. This is the second thing to vote on.

Vote either by responding to this post or a telegram to this account or Baladullah and saying yes or no for issue 1 (allowing Valddera back into the organization) and yes or no for issue 2 (using some of the General Fund to assist the reconstruction and recovery in Valddera).

May Allah swt grant the people of Valddera lasting peace, justice, and development.

[i]Abdullah al-Barazakh
General Secretary of the EOIC[/i]

[b]WITHDRAWAL FROM VALDDERA[/b]

[i]After heavy fighting and international backlash for the Daesunite invasion of Valddera and emancipation of the fascist ISV-aligned People's Republic of Valddera, Daesunite president Hwangok has finally ordered the anticipated withdrawal of Daesunite military forces from Valddera. The 12,300 personnel currently occupying Valddera will begin a withdrawal process expected to last until June, where Valddera asylum seekers may be fitted on flights to Daesun if their refugee status is approved. Daesun will also oversee that military withdrawal is swift and careful, to ensure space is made for the 2027 FEFA WC taking place in Valddera.

While also issuing a formal apology to Valdderan citizens affected by the occupation, Daesun will re-distribute 5 billion USD in aid to Valdderan reconstruction and development.

[b]Antonio Consortium Acquires Shahrestan Olympic Stadium:[/b]

The Antonio Consortium has been scooping up and taking large chunks of the Valderran economy ever since the newly established government gave permission for them and three other UREV corporations to take charge in the development and stability of the country. Large domestic businesses have been purchased and turned into subsidiaries under the Antonio Consortium, while large infrastructure projects and manufacturing hubs are sprung up from the pockets of the company.

And now the most recent acquisition on March 22nd of 2027 has seen the company purchase and gain full ownership of the Shahrestan Stadium as well as the broadcasting rights to the stadium and games played by the local football team. The Antonio Consortium invested millions into the local area, mainly in infrastructure and creatings jobs for the local population, and by purchasing this stadium it hopes to further expand their influence in the Valdderan market.

An Antonio Consortium spokesperson has stated that, [i]"millions more will be spent renovating and turning this stadium into a world-class location for fans of football."[/i] The company has begun renovations to expand capacity to 100,000 people and is modernising the interior and pitch, having partnered with Amery Holdings to receive construction support for the additional seating. The stadium and broadcast rights are reserved solely for the company, and with the upcoming football world cup, the first year revenue is expected to return millions in profits.

Alongside the stadium, Antonio Consortium will be purchasing local and foreign football talent and creating a new club, with an initial $200 million delegated to purchasing the best players they can. The football club created are the Shahrestan Lions, and their expected manager is to be Rurik Malddov, an experienced and long-time UREV manager who has won 4 Federal Cups. Antonio Consortium has managed to acquire free broadcasting rights when the Shahrestan Lions are playing, giving them no competitors for advertisement space.
